name: taskmanager-js-tests
description: Jest unit tests + Playwright E2E tests for Task Manager JavaScript

comments.overrides: Force patched versions of DEV-only transitive deps flagged high-severity by the weekly advisory check. Not shipped to prod — the app runtime is Python, and `npm audit --omit=dev` is already clean. #306: first pinned js-yaml 3.15.0 + brace-expansion 5.0.8. #310 (2026-08-01): NEW advisories landed against those exact pins — GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895 (brace-expansion ≤5.0.8, CVE-2026-14257 mitigation bypass) and CVE-2026-59870 (js-yaml !!omap quadratic CPU, 3.x fix NOT backported). Bumped brace-expansion→5.0.9 and js-yaml→5.2.3 (had to leave the 3.x line — no 3.x fix exists). js-yaml 5.x drops the legacy safeLoad API, so verified the dev tree (jest coverage via babel-plugin-istanbul→load-nyc-config, jscpd) still runs green after the bump. #311 (2026-09-01): browserslist ≤4.28.6 flagged high (GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx unbounded-memory OOM + GHSA-73wf-gq98-2v4g prototype write via untrusted stats); pinned →4.28.8 (patch bump within 4.28.x, via jest→@babel/core→helper-compilation-targets). #346 (2026-09-30): the weekly advisory sweep landed THREE new brace-expansion DoS advisories (GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr quadratic `{a},b}` rewrite, GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7 + GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p uncontrolled recursion / stack exhaustion) whose range 4.0.0-5.0.11 swallowed the #310 pin of 5.0.9 -> bumped to 5.0.12. Same sweep flagged js-yaml 5.0.0-5.4.0 (GHSA-r3ph-w7gj-g6xm, maxTotalMergeKeys does not bound CPU on empty merge sources), which swallowed the #310 pin of 5.2.3 -> bumped to 5.4.2. Both reached only through jest's coverage tooling (minimatch/glob and @istanbuljs/load-nyc-config); `npm audit --omit=dev` is clean, so nothing here ships — the app runtime is Python and the browser gets hand-written JS with no bundler.
